Question 3

Find the fundamental vector product of the surface defined by the equations

x=u,y=v,z=u2−v2.

a
 ⟨−2u,2v,1⟩
b
 ⟨u,u−2v,v⟩
c
 ⟨u,−2v,u+v⟩
d
 ⟨−2u,2v,2u−2v⟩
